approvalSource: explicit user approval in conversation to standardize each common service administrator under the service subdomain /admin path, followed by the instruction to build it
summary: Standardize service-local administration entrypoints at /admin while preserving admin.ekodi.kr as the central control plane and EKODI Core RBAC as the authorization source of truth.
authorizationRule: service-local admin paths are entrypoints only; EKODI Core RBAC and central authentication remain authoritative
rolloutPolicy: additive; existing working admin routes remain valid while newly registered service admin URLs are introduced only when their route is implemented
rollbackPlan: remove service adminUrl registrations and local /admin handoffs, revert constitution to 1.4.0, and keep admin.ekodi.kr as the sole administrative entry without changing service public URLs or workspace identity
